summary: Accepted ADR dated 2026-07-05 that supersedes ADR-007's deferral of chat-surface renderer choice while carrying forward and hardening the engine rule. Context: Hoplight renders untrusted card and extension text, so direct DOM construction makes HTML-sink safety depend on caller convention; React escapes text by default and repository gates ban explicit escape hatches. Roadmap chat and agent surfaces plus agent-context plans require serializable UI state; closure-held vanilla DOM is agent-opaque while store-driven React matches comparable production apps. Decision: UI layer is React 19 plus TSX transpiled natively by Bun with no Vite or Next, bundled into the same single exe; Zustand for shell store plus one store per app; no URL router; CSS Modules over tokens with no Tailwind; whole UI converts to one idiom; app contract v2 is React component export plus manifest including agentSurface descriptor; engine rule forbids renderer imports in converter canonical model engines and star-core files; react react-dom and zustand are direct dependencies covered by license audit while new dependencies follow normal review without a special commit trailer; dangerouslySetInnerHTML and raw HTML sinks are banned outside an allowlist. Consequences: rewrite bounded by pure cores as spec; ordinary text is escaped by default and the sink gate enforces escape-hatch policy; established tooling lowers maintenance cost; framework churn risk accepted with engine immune.

sections.title: Context
sections.summary: Two constraints crystallized after ADR-007. Hoplight renders untrusted card and extension text, so direct DOM construction makes HTML-sink safety depend on every caller; React escapes text by default and gates ban explicit escape hatches. Roadmap chat and agent surfaces plus per-surface context require serializable UI state; closure-held vanilla DOM is agent-opaque while store-driven React matches comparable production applications.

sections.title: Decision
sections.summary: UI layer is React 19 plus TSX transpiled natively by Bun without Vite or Next and bundled into the same single exe. State is Zustand with one shell store plus one store per app surface; navigation is state-driven with no URL router. Styling is CSS Modules over the existing token system with no Tailwind. The UI converts whole shell and every app folder to one idiom; until conversion lands, vanilla surfaces remain the behavioral spec. App contract v2 is a React component export plus manifest including an agentSurface descriptor of state selector and offered actions so every surface is agent-readable by construction. Engine rule unchanged and hardened: converter, canonical model, engines, and every star-core.ts stay pure framework-less TS; a renderer import there is a guardrail violation. React, react-dom, and zustand are direct dependencies covered by license audit; new dependencies follow normal review without a special commit trailer. dangerouslySetInnerHTML and raw HTML-injection sinks are banned by repo gates outside an explicit sanctioned allowlist.

sections.title: Consequences
sections.summary: Editor slice 1 and the current shell are rebuilt in React during conversion; their behavior and pure tested cores are the spec so the rewrite is bounded. Ordinary text rendering is escaped by default, while repository gates separately enforce the raw-HTML escape-hatch ban. Established tooling and contributor familiarity reduce maintenance cost. React version churn is accepted and bounded because the engine remains isolated.
